<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, touching **8** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**5** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`  _(via batchTransaction (sdk, the bare tail of client method data.batchTransaction, bound to POST /api/v1/batch), data.batchTransaction (sdk, the route ledger binds it to POST /api/v1/batch), /api/v1/batch (route, a path literal in a comment in AUTHORING_RULES; a path literal in a comment on a changed line; a path literal in lintInlineEditBulk))_
- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`  _(via AUTHORING_RULES (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/frontend/data-objectstack.mdx`  _(via batchTransaction (sdk, the bare tail of client method data.batchTransaction, bound to POST /api/v1/batch))_
- `content/docs/frontend/data-source.mdx`  _(via batchTransaction (sdk, the bare tail of client method data.batchTransaction, bound to POST /api/v1/batch), data.batchTransaction (sdk, the route ledger binds it to POST /api/v1/batch), /api/v1/batch (route, a path literal in a comment in AUTHORING_RULES; a path literal in a comment on a changed line; a path literal in lintInlineEditBulk))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/http-protocol.mdx`  _(via batchTransaction (sdk, the bare tail of client method data.batchTransaction, bound to POST /api/v1/batch), data.batchTransaction (sdk, the route ledger binds it to POST /api/v1/batch), /api/v1/batch (route, a path literal in a comment in AUTHORING_RULES; a path literal in a comment on a changed line; a path literal in lintInlineEditBulk))_

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/batch (route, a path literal in a comment in AUTHORING_RULES; a path literal in a comment on a changed line; a path literal in lintInlineEditBulk))_
- `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx`  _(via batchTransaction (sdk, the bare tail of client method data.batchTransaction, bound to POST /api/v1/batch))_
- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via batchTransaction (sdk, the bare tail of client method data.batchTransaction, bound to POST /api/v1/batch), data.batchTransaction (sdk, the route ledger binds it to POST /api/v1/batch))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **4** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 082f9c2945260fd9b29951caff1c49f6dccab4ea` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `8e52f97ee3443f8d57ddaf9118152eceb7d351bb` — the merge of head `ef4b6bc350174e99a16427d1745754bdfa14a548` into base `082f9c2945260fd9b29951caff1c49f6dccab4ea`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 8e52f97ee3443f8d57ddaf9118152eceb7d351bb && git checkout 8e52f97ee3443f8d57ddaf9118152eceb7d351bb
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 082f9c2945260fd9b29951caff1c49f6dccab4ea ef4b6bc350174e99a16427d1745754bdfa14a548 && git checkout -B drift-repro 082f9c2945260fd9b29951caff1c49f6dccab4ea && git merge --no-ff ef4b6bc350174e99a16427d1745754bdfa14a548

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 082f9c2945260fd9b29951caff1c49f6dccab4ea
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 082f9c2945260fd9b29951caff1c49f6dccab4ea` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

- Registering it moves the printed author-time rule count 68 → 69; four `content/docs` transcript pages follow (`check:docs-transcript-drift`).
- Tests: `data-model-rules.test.ts` drives the rule through `runAuthoringRules` for the three commands (64/64); the lint suite (9091, wiring test included) and the 11 CLI test files that read the registry (262) are green. Ablation re-run: 7 red, 1 green before restore, 64/64 after.
- Local gates: 123 derived, every exit 0, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED. `overlap-check.mjs` clean against `main`.
- CI on this head: 72 check-runs, 60 success, 12 skipped, none red or pending.
- The PR body was rewritten for this head by the card thread.
- Landing tier: Tier H (`packages/lint/**`, `packages/cli/**`, `skills/**`, `content/docs/**`; the changeset releases `@objectstack/lint`). After L1 ACCEPT and an at-tier contract review PASS on this head, the area hands it to the seat; it stays draft.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2da6508c15d60e314f3a3611c04ed970665f4f0e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md, skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md, skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json + packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts, packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts, packages/lint/src/index.ts, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs
Security-touching: yes

Inputs read: cards #34567 and #34566 (bodies and all five comments each), PR #34600 (body, file list, comments), the net diff against merge base `8dd8192c` (14 files, +232 −27), and the head's check-runs: 72 runs, every one `success` or `skipped`, none failed, none pending. The rest of the diff (`.changeset/`, four `content/docs/` transcript lines, `packages/cli/test/data-model-rules.test.ts`) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT` and is not reviewed here.

`Security-touching: yes` is meant: the new sentence in both skills and the rule's fix line teach an author to add `'bulk'` to `enable.apiMethods`, the object's API-exposure whitelist (the axis `packages/spec/src/data/api-derivation.ts` itself names a security concern). No access finding.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set: unchanged, right. No schema, parser or route is touched. The new rule is `tier: 'advisory'`, emits `warning` only, and no reviewed command carries a warnings-fail flag (`lint.ts`, `validate.ts`, `compile.ts` on `main` have none), so no stack that built before is refused now.
- Public surface of `@objectstack/lint`: two added exports, `lintInlineEditBulk` and `RELATIONSHIP_INLINE_EDIT_NEEDS_BULK`, and one added `AUTHORING_RULES` entry (`commands: ALL`, `input: 'parsed'`, `surfaces: CLI_ONLY`). Additive, right. The entry is shaped exactly as its neighbours `lintUniqueDeclarations` and `lintLegacyOrganizationComposites`.
- Printed author-time rule count 68 to 69: follows from the one new registry entry, right; the transcript gate derives it and its check-run is green.
- Skills surface: one form-type table rewritten, one paragraph and one sentence added in `objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`, one sentence in `relationships.md`, one table row in `lint-rules.md`, one eval case; five restatements cut. Each cut keeps a home at this head: the row-by-row sentence at `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:231`, the derived-FK and roll-up paragraph in the line-item paragraph and its pointer to objectstack-data, the `subforms` sentence in the new one-line pointer, and the lint-clean paragraph in the table rows above it. Right.
- Ratchet rows: `objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` 3833 to 3921, `relationships.md` 4232 to 4229, `lint-rules.md` 970 to 934. Measured from the git objects: 15349 to 15704 bytes, 16925 to 16916, 3829 to 3735; `ceil((15704 − 20) / 4) = 3921`, `ceil(16916 / 4) = 4229`, `ceil(3735 / 4) = 934`. All three rows sit at the measurement with zero headroom. Right.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no — confirmed. The diff refuses nothing and widens nothing an author can write; `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct (no key, value or metadata type changes).

`@objectstack/skills` patch and `@objectstack/lint` patch match AGENTS.md rule 3 on `main` (`none` takes `patch`; a non-protocol change ships `patch`). Both declaration lines are line-initial in the PR body and in the changeset body. The changeset's account of the rule (id, export names, three commands, advisory, once per object, fix line) matches the tree. `Check Changeset` is green on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag, test in the shared harness file instead of a card-named file: accepted; it is outside this record's scope and the area accepted it.
- Dev flag, the rule and the sentence cover the child object and `lookup` children: correct, and required by the code. `packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts:368` gates every op on its own object (`apiAccessDenialFromEnable(obj.enable, op.object, 'bulk', { bulkChild: op.action })`), and `attachInlineSubforms` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx:714`) inlines both `master_detail` and `lookup` fields.
- Dev flag, two ratchet rows lowered and one raised: answered under ④ (ratchet file).
- Dev flag, rule moved from `lintDataModel` to its own registry entry: correct. It answers the round-one open question (reach was `os lint` only) and meets #34566 acceptance 1, which names compile time.
- Dev flag, `lint-rules.md` keeps its `os lint` framing: true as written; see N2.
- `open_questions`: the one remaining entry asks for this review; answered by this record. The round-one question on reach is closed by the registry move.
- Out-of-scope finding, `relationship/line-items-inline-edit` tests `def.inlineEdit !== true`: confirmed on `main` (`packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts:1090`), outside this diff, carrier none. Escalated to the seat as a follow-up card candidate: a `*_line` child that already declares `'grid'` or `'form'` is told to consider `inlineEdit: true`.
- Second road of #34566 (stop gating the form's save on `bulk`): not taken, correctly; it widens what REST accepts and belongs to `domain:rest` with its own review.
- SQL push-down: no query, id materialisation or in-app join is added anywhere in the diff. The rule is a pure pass over the in-memory stack. No finding.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` — Form Views (card #34567).** Each statement checked against `main`:

- `simple` is the default: `FormViewSchema.type` is `.default('simple')`, described as "stacked sections, the default" (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:5155`). The 15-field cap had no counterpart in the schema or the renderer. Holds.
- `tabbed` is "one tab per section" (same describe line); its two costs are the card's staging measurement. Holds against acceptance 1.
- `collapse: 'collapsed'` on a `fieldGroups` entry: the enum is `none | expanded | collapsed` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:1453`). `collapsed: true` on a section listing its own `fields`: `FormSectionSchema.collapsed`, which implies `collapsible`, and is refused beside `group` (`view.zod.ts:4372`, `:4484`), so naming the object's key for grouped sections is the right split. Holds.
- `columns` (form or section) as a per-row ceiling a narrow screen lowers, two when unset: the section describe says "the author's ceiling ... a renderer collapses it on narrow containers", and `UNDECLARED_SECTION_COLUMNS = 2` with `sectionColumnsFor` falling back section, then form, then two (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/autoLayout.ts:368`). Holds.
- `modalSize` `sm` to `full`, `lg` or `xl` when unset: the enum is `sm | default | lg | xl | full` (`view.zod.ts:5244`); `ModalForm.tsx:502` uses an authored value as written and otherwise infers a size bounded to `lg` or `xl` from the drawn columns and the field count. Holds.
- Acceptance 2 (one line of guidance each for `collapsed`, `columns`, `modalSize`): met.

**`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` Master-Detail Forms item 1 and `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` § Inline Editing (card #34566).** "A parent or child declaring `enable.apiMethods` must list `'bulk'`, or that save is refused `405 OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`."

- The save path: `MasterDetailForm.tsx` sends every save, create and edit, through `runBatchTransaction` ("Persistence ALWAYS goes through dataSource.batchTransaction", `:1888`), parent as op 0, and the adapter treats a 405 as a hard error on a backend that declares atomic batch (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts:5179`). So the parent is gated on every save of that form, and the child whenever the save carries a child row.
- The gate: `batch-routes.ts:368` as above; the 405 body's code is `OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` (`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:562`).
- "declaring": `resolveEffectiveApiMethods` returns `unrestricted` for an absent `apiMethods` and `deny-all` for `[]`. Only a declared list can refuse. Holds.
- #34566 acceptance 2 (the precondition is readable in the skill text): met, in both named sections.

**`skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md`.** The new row gives the id `relationship/inline-edit-needs-bulk`, severity `warning`, and the trigger "`inlineEdit` while the parent's or child's `enable.apiMethods` omits `'bulk'`". Id, severity and trigger agree with the code. The severity vocabulary above the table already covers `warning`. Holds.

**`packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts` — `lintInlineEditBulk`, sentence by sentence against the skill.**

- Fires on a relationship field (`lookup` or `master_detail`) whose `inlineEdit` is `true`, `'grid'` or `'form'` and that has a `reference`: the same three conditions `attachInlineSubforms` reads, and the same three values as the spec's own predicate (`packages/spec/src/data/related-list-body-table.ts:59`) and `FieldSchema.inlineEdit` (`field.zod.ts:2083`). No drift.
- The verdict is `isApiOperationAllowed(resolveEffectiveApiMethods(enable), 'bulk')`, the two functions the REST gate itself resolves through, not a copied table. Undeclared and `null` stay silent, `[]` and a list holding only legacy values fire. Agrees with the route.
- Targets are the parent and the child's own object, each once (`reported`), located at `objects[N].enable.apiMethods`, with the fix `add 'bulk' to NAME.enable.apiMethods`. The message names the 405 code. Severity `warning`. Matches the skill row, the changeset and the tests.
- Break attempts. Self-referencing relationship: one finding, deduplicated. Parent outside the stack: skipped, a false negative the rule cannot see into and does not claim. An object with `apiEnabled: false`: silent, correct, since that is a different refusal (404) the sentence does not speak to. A list with `'bulk'` but without the write itself: silent, correct, since the single-record form fails the same way. A child that declares a list without `bulk` while only the parent is edited: warned although that particular save passes; the warning is still right for any save that carries a row. No false positive found that contradicts the sentence.
- `refOf` can throw on an unreadable `reference` shape; that is the file's standing contract (#13053) shared with the sibling rules, and a parsed stack cannot carry such a shape.

**`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` and `packages/lint/src/index.ts`.** The entry maps `suggestion` to `info` and `fix` to `hint` like its neighbours; `commands: ALL` is what puts the warning on `os lint`, `os validate` and `os build`, as the changeset and the PR title claim. The exports match the changeset's names. Agrees.

**`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`.** Only three data rows of `CEILINGS` and their comments change; the gate's logic is untouched, so this is not a gate weakening. Two rows move down to their measurements, which tightens them (the `lint-rules.md` row loses 12 tokens of standing headroom). The one raise, +88 tokens on `objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`, follows the raise path already used by rows on `main` (ruling record 6513306068: cut restatement first, raise the remainder by measurement): 320 bytes of restatement were cut from the same file first, the remainder pays for text both cards order by name (the three guidance items of #34567 acceptance 2, the precondition of #34566 acceptance 2), and the row is pinned at the measurement with zero headroom. Justified. The two in-file comments' arithmetic matches the byte counts above.

**`skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` — case 19.**

S1 (should-fix) — the case's `must_contain` rejects an answer its own `expected_output` and the skill both sanction. `expected_output` allows "`collapsed: true` on the four rarely filled ones (or `collapse: 'collapsed'` on those `fieldGroups` entries of the object)", and the skill paragraph names the `fieldGroups` route first; an answer that takes it writes `sections: [{ group: ... }]` and never contains the string `collapsed: true`, so the string check scores a correct answer as a failure. Fix either side so the two agree: drop `collapsed: true` from `must_contain` (the `must_not_contain` of `type: 'tabbed'` and the `modalSize` token already carry the case), or remove the parenthetical alternative from `expected_output` and have the prompt ask for sections that list their own fields. The rest of the case holds: the prompt matches the card's scenario (many fields, six sections, New dialog, wide screens), and `type: 'tabbed'` is absent from its own expected text.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract):

- N1 — a child surfaced only through a form view's `subforms` or a page block's `details`, with no `inlineEdit` on the relationship, is saved through the same batch and needs `bulk` the same way; the rule and the sentence speak of `inlineEdit` only. Follow-up card candidate, not a defect of what is written.
- N2 — `lint-rules.md` opens with "`os lint` checks", while this one row is also reported by `os validate` and `os build`. True as written, incomplete; the file's budget is the stated reason. Accepted deviation.
- N3 — the entry reuses `RUNTIME_OBJECT_ADVISORY_VOLUME` as its `surfaceReason`. That reason is about advisory volume per object write; this rule is rare and forecasts a refusal, so a Studio author who narrows `apiMethods` gets no warning. Whether it should cross the runtime door is a follow-up decision.
- N4 — the Form Views paragraph does not say to keep a required field out of a collapsed section. "Collapse what is rarely filled" covers the intent; whether the renderer reopens a collapsed section that holds a failed required field was not established in this read.
- N5 — case 19 also requires the literal `type: 'simple'`, which the skill now teaches as the default; an answer that omits `type` is valid metadata. Consistent with case 1's convention of writing it out; fold into the S1 fix or leave.

One graded finding is open on this head, S1; its fix earns a delta review.

## 席位核对

**L1 first review — ACCEPT** · head `2da6508c15d60e314f3a3611c04ed970665f4f0e` · cards #34567 (chain head) + #34566 (member) · read 2026-11-17T04:23Z by L1-d (area o2-S)

Read on GitHub and on a local worktree at this head, not off the report: `get_files` (14 paths), the diff, both cards, the final-head comment 6938048761, the head's check-runs.

**Checklist**

- Shape: draft, base `main`, both closing keywords stand alone on their own lines; both cards are delivered in full (#34567 acceptance 1–3: table no longer steers to `tabbed`, one sentence each for `collapsed`/`columns`/`modalSize`, eval case 19; #34566 acceptance 1–2: author-time warning with a named fix, and the precondition in both skills), so `Fixes` is right. No closing keyword sits next to any other card number in the body.
- Scope: no `content/docs/releases/` change; the four `content/docs/` edits are transcript count lines only (68 → 69), which `pnpm check:docs-transcript-drift` re-derived at this head (exit 0, 4 declared values equal the registry). `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/skills` are both published (no `private`); the changeset releases both as patch. Changeset prose checked sentence by sentence against the diff: the form-layout paragraph, the "undeclared `apiMethods` allows it" sentence, the `true`/`'grid'`/`'form'` triggers, "registered for all three commands", "advisory and never fails a build", and the "cutting text stated elsewhere" closer all match.
- Premises, re-read at this head: `packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts:368` gates every batch op with `apiAccessDenialFromEnable(obj.enable, op.object, 'bulk', { bulkChild: op.action })`; `resolveEffectiveApiMethods` treats undeclared as unrestricted and `[]`/non-array as deny-all, and `isApiOperationAllowed(eff, 'bulk')` reads the `bulk` primitive — so the rule asks the spec's own resolver, no copied table. UI text: `FormViewSchema.type` default `'simple'`; `modalSize` enum `sm|default|lg|xl|full`; `FormSectionSchema.collapsed: true` refused beside `group` (the skill sends grouped sections to `fieldGroups[].collapse: 'collapsed'`, which the object schema carries); section `columns` 1–4 described as a ceiling; `UNDECLARED_SECTION_COLUMNS = 2` (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/autoLayout.ts:368`); `ModalForm.tsx` picks `lg`/`xl` when `modalSize` is unset. Every skill sentence holds.
- Cuts keep a home: "row-by-row" lives at `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:231`; roll-ups at `rules/relationships.md` § Roll-up Summaries; "derived from the DATA MODEL" stays in the line-item paragraph.
- Ratchet: byte readings match the comments (`objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` 15349 → 15704, `relationships.md` 16925 → 16916, `lint-rules.md` 3829 → 3735); `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exit 0. Raise path quotes ruling record 6513306068 verbatim.

**Spot readings at this head (own runs)**

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/data-model-rules.test.ts` — Tests 64 passed (after building the CLI's dependency closure locally).
- `packages/lint/src/authoring-rule-wiring.test.ts` — Tests 26 passed (advisory tier: the guard reads the rule source for `'error'`).
